name: Concept A (baseline): Chemical + Solar Oberth + tether chain
description: docs/analyses/reference-scenarios.md §2, concept-a-baseline. Starts on the post-Jupiter-assist transfer ellipse (r_a = 5.204 AU, r_p = 6.0 R_sun) at aphelion; the C3 = 120 km²/s² departure and retrograde JGA are not modelled. 12.0 km/s perihelion burn gives v_inf,SOM = 76.42 km/s; 12 speculative Zylon tethers x 3.0 km/s (+36.0 km/s) are placed far out (10–30 AU) so they add almost linearly. Doc reference: 112.42 km/s far-field linear (3.75e-4 c); 161.58 km/s if the tethers acted at perihelion.
